thought.text: Let me verify the package.json was really fixed:

reasoning_content: The error is still showing the old "type": "module" in the error message, but it seems like PM2 is caching the old package.json or using old logs. Let me check what package.json actually has now:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check current package.json content
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("=== Server package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /root/opt/areloria/package.json")
print("=== Root package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Clear PM2 logs and cache completely
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /root/.pm2/pm2.pid /root/.pm2/logs/* && pm2 kill && sleep 2")
print("Cleared PM2 cache")

# Start fresh again
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 start /root/opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env && sleep 5 && pm2 list")
print("\n=== Fresh PM2 Start ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
